name: Kyowa Exeo Corporation
summary: Kyowa Exeo Corporation provides telecommunication carrier, urban infrastructure, and system solutions worldwide. It plans, designs, installs, operates, and maintains various telecommunications equipment of telecom carriers, such as access networks fiber optic cables, network facilities, electric power equipment, outdoor and indoor mobile communication base station, and base station equipment. The company also constructs and maintains CATV cables, railroad communication network, elimination of utility poles, underground utilities, electrical facilities, data centers, photovoltaic plants, wastes treatment facilities, and biomass boilers. In addition, theit engages in the development, maintenance, and operation of cloud-based enterprise communications network systems and various enterprise systems for telecom carriers for finance and manufacturing sectors. The company was formerly known as Kyowa Densetsu Kaisha, Ltd. and changed its name to Kyowa Exeo Corporation in May 1991. Kyowa Exeo Corporation was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
